inputs.text: New York City’s decision to release an illegal immigrant gang member, despite the danger he posed, shows what happens when sanctuary politics take priority over public safety. ICE had to step in while local officials obstructed federal enforcement. Families should not bear the risk because officials put ideology ahead of their basic duty: protect citizens and uphold the law.

output.main_topic: New York City’s decision to release an illegal immigrant gang member and criticism of sanctuary politics
subtopics: Officials’ duty to protect citizens and uphold the law
output.narrative_frame: Criticism of sanctuary politics as prioritizing ideology over public safety and impeding federal enforcement.
opinions: Sanctuary politics take priority over public safety.
Families should not bear the risk.
Officials put ideology ahead of their basic duty to protect citizens and uphold the law.
